Frame_1: The chicken breast on the blue cutting board appears whole and untouched, its pale pink surface smooth and consistent, displaying the typical characteristics of raw poultry. It's nestled against the curve of the cutting board, seemingly just placed there and ready for preparation. The knife, poised just at the edge of the chicken, suggests the start of the dicing process, with the hand positioned to make the initial cut. No pieces have been removed yet, and the chicken sits in contrast to the separate pile of freshly chopped ingredients nearby.
Frame_2: In this scene, the raw chicken breast has been partially sliced into. Several strips have been cut lengthwise across the breast, each strip approximately a centimeter in width. The strips remain attached at one end, indicating that the slicing is only halfway completed. The fingers of the hand are curled inward to hold the chicken steady, showing careful technique to avoid slipping while cutting. The blade of the knife is now dirty with the juices of the chicken, marking the progress in preparation.
Frame_3: The chicken breast has now been transformed into cubed pieces, a common preparation for many recipes. The pieces are somewhat irregular in size, ranging from smaller than a centimeter to about two centimeters in length, showing a more rustic chop. The now empty area of the cutting board where the whole breast previously lay emphasizes the work completed. The hand holds a few pieces of chicken between the fingers, possibly for transferring to a cooking vessel or to even out the size of the pieces through further cutting.
State_change_caption: The chicken breast undergoes a visible transformation through these frames. Initially, it sits whole, with the anticipation of the dicing to come. Then, it is methodically sliced into strips that are still connected, showing the preparatory stage of dicing. Finally, the chicken is fully diced into cubes, ready for the next step in a recipe. This progression demonstrates a careful and deliberate preparation technique, moving from whole to portioned with each step designed to ensure even cooking and flavor distribution in the finished dish.
